title: (111) Facet-engineered SnO2 as Electron Transport Layer for Efficient and Stable Triple-Cation Perovskite Solar Cells
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, Accepted Manuscript
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE00339C, Paper
Keshav Kumar Kumar Sharma, Rohit Rohit, Sochannao Machinao, K. Ramesh
In this study, we report the (111) facet-engineered cubic phase tin(IV) oxide (C-SnO2) as a novel electron transport layer (ETL) for triple-cation mixed-halide Cs0.05(FA0.83MA0.17)0.95Pb(I0.83Br0.17)3 perovskite solar cells (PSCs). The C-SnO2...
